description: This is a Java source file defining the MainViewModel class for an Android application. The class manages UI-related data, handles data synchronization with a backend (including capabilities and notes), and interacts with the repository layer. It also manages selection states, categories, and account information for a notes application, providing live data streams for the UI to observe.

classes.name: MainViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class managing UI data and interactions for the main notes activity, including account/session management, note retrieval, synchronization, and navigation state.

methods.name: restoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores ViewModel state from saved instance handle, restoring current account, search term, selected, and expanded categories.

methods.name: getCurrentAccount
methods.description: Returns LiveData for the current account, filtered for distinct changes.

methods.name: postCurrentAccount
methods.description: Sets the current account, updates branding, resets related navigation states if account changes.

methods.name: getSearchTerm
methods.description: Returns LiveData for the search string, filtered for distinct changes.

methods.name: postSearchTerm
methods.description: Updates the current search term.

methods.name: getSelectedCategory
methods.description: Returns LiveData for the currently selected category, filtered for distinct changes.

methods.name: postSelectedCategory
methods.description: Updates the selected navigation category and manages expansion state logic for categories.

methods.name: getCategorySortingMethodOfSelectedCategory
methods.description: Provides sorting method info for the selected category as a paired LiveData.

methods.name: modifyCategoryOrder
methods.description: Allows modification of a category’s sorting order.

methods.name: getExpandedCategory
methods.description: Returns LiveData of the currently expanded category for UI purposes.

methods.name: postExpandedCategory
methods.description: Updates the expanded category state.

methods.name: getNotesListLiveData
methods.description: Constructs and returns LiveData for the list of notes based on current account, category, search, and sorting states.

methods.name: fromNotes
methods.description: Helper to convert list of notes into UI list items, respecting sorting and category.

methods.name: synchronizeCapabilitiesAndNotes
methods.description: Performs synchronization of server capabilities and notes for given account.

methods.name: synchronizeCapabilities
methods.description: Updates server capabilities, possibly updating local data with server info.

methods.name: synchronizeNotes
methods.description: Syncs notes from server or local storage for a given account.

methods.name: getSyncStatus
methods.description: Returns LiveData indicating if sync is active/failed.

methods.name: getSyncErrors
methods.description: Returns LiveData containing sync error logs.

methods.name: hasMultipleAccountsConfigured
methods.description: Indicates if more than one account is configured.

methods.name: getLocalAccountByAccountName
methods.description: Retrieves a local account record by account name, thread-safe.

methods.name: getAccounts
methods.description: Provides list of all local accounts.

methods.name: setCategory
methods.description: Assigns a category to notes by ID.

methods.name: moveNoteToAnotherAccount
methods.description: Transfers a note to a different account.

methods.name: toggleFavoriteAndSync
methods.description: Toggles favorite status for a note and syncs.

methods.name: deleteNoteAndSync
methods.description: Deletes a note and syncs change.

methods.name: deleteNotesAndSync
methods.description: Deletes multiple notes and syncs.

methods.name: addAccount
methods.description: Adds a new account with server info and capabilities.

methods.name: getFullNote$
methods.description: Fetches a complete note by ID as LiveData.

methods.name: getFullNote
methods.description: Fetches a complete note by ID synchronously.

methods.name: getFullNotesWithCategory
methods.description: Fetches multiple notes with their categories.

methods.name: addNoteAndSync
methods.description: Adds a new note and performs synchronization.

methods.name: updateNoteAndSync
methods.description: Updates an existing note and syncs.

methods.name: createOrUpdateSingleNoteWidgetData
methods.description: Creates or updates widget data associated with a note.

methods.name: getLocalModifiedNotes
methods.description: Returns list of local notes modified locally that are pending sync.

methods.name: getAccountsCount
methods.description: Returns count of configured accounts.

methods.name: collectNoteContents
methods.description: Concatenates contents of multiple notes into a single string.

methods.name: containsNonInfrastructureRelatedItems
methods.description: Analyzes exceptions to check if they are related to infrastructure failures or software issues.
